subject: Operational Stability and Change Governance - RFI
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda.park@apexbank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Apex Procurement <procurement@apexbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Operational Stability and Change Governance - RFI

Aditya —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our vendor due diligence for production inference, our control owners have asked for a short RFI focused on operational stability and change governance. Top asks:

- A high-level change control overview (RFC process, approvals, emergency change handling).
- Evidence of runbooks / deployment SOPs and canary/rollback controls.
- Capacity planning and peak forecasting for a typical bank workload (include how you validate capacity).
- Availability SLOs, incident postmortem cadence, and audit logs retention policy.

Can you provide the artifacts and annotations by EOD Aug 17 PST? Also include the name and contact for your SOC2 auditor or compliance lead so we can coordinate any follow-ups.

If anything above is out of scope, flag it and propose an acceptable substitute.

Thanks,
Linda Park
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Apex Regional Bank

(attachment: vendor-rfi-template.xlsx)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@apexbank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operational Stability and Change Governance - RFI

Linda —

Appreciate the clear list. We can cover all items you listed and will assemble an evidence pack. Proposed plan:

1) Draft change control summary + example RFCs and approval matrix (Neha).
2) Attach runbook and deployment SOP with canary/rollback section (Aditya).
3) Provide capacity planning spreadsheet with monthly forecasts and recent stress-test results (Laura + infra).
4) Summarize SLOs, incident cadence and retention policy; include SOC2 contact.

We will deliver the package by EOD Aug 17 PST. Quick clarifying question: what retention window are you expecting for audit logs (syslog, access, and request traces)? We typically retain 12 months by default and offer 24 months for enterprise contracts; we can include both artifacts if you need two-year retention evidence.

Attached are placeholders for the evidence files we plan to include — will replace with final exports next week.

Attachments: redwood_change-control-runbook.pdf (stub), capacity-planning-monthly-metrics-2026.csv (stub)

If you prefer a short walkthrough call before the deliverable, I can schedule 30 minutes next week.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao

Date: 2026-08-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operational Stability and Change Governance - RFI

Aditya —

Thanks. For our control baseline please provide evidence for 24 months retention where available; if some artifacts are only 12 months we need a short rationale and a roadmap to 24 months. Also include a named SOC2 auditor contact and the last audit date.

Please include capacity forecasts covering a typical peak-month scenario (e.g., month-over-month request growth and planned buffer).

We will review the initial pack and follow up with any redlines by Aug 24.

Regards,
Linda

(Quick note: procurement@apexbank.com will circulate this to our security council.)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-08-12T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Operational Stability and Change Governance - RFI (internal tasking)

Team —

Forwarding Apex's ask and Linda's follow-up. Action items:

- Neha: compile change control artifacts (RFC template, approval matrix, emergency change SOP). Annotate with system owners and ticket examples.
- Rishi: export capacity planning metrics for the last 12 months and produce a 24-month projection with peak-month stress tests and buffer assumptions. Include CPU/GPU utilization, queue latency, and horizontal scaling run rates.
- Aditya: assemble runbook and make sure the deployment SOP includes our canary metrics and automated rollback thresholds.

Note: Apex requires 24 months retention where possible. Where we only have 12 months, include a short note and the timeline to expand. Put final artifacts in the APX RFI Drive folder and tell Aditya when ready.

Thanks — please flag any blockers by EOD tomorrow.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Linda / Apex team —

Attached is our consolidated RFI evidence pack. Summary highlights below and attached artifacts in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAPX-RFI-evidence

Key points
- Change control: We enforce a documented RFC lifecycle (Dev -> Review -> Approval -> Scheduled rollout). Emergency changes use an accelerated approval flow with mandatory post-change review and incident tagging. See attached redwood_change-control-runbook.pdf (pages 3–7 show approval matrix and example RFC IDs).
- Deployment SOP & runbooks: deployment-sop-checklist.docx includes pre-deploy validations, automated canary rollout policy (5% traffic for 30 minutes, automated health checks) and rollback thresholds. Runbook contains manual recovery steps and contact list.
- Capacity planning: capacity-planning-monthly-metrics-2026.csv contains M/M traffic, 95th/99th tail latency, GPU utilization and headroom calculations. We run quarterly load tests and maintain a 20% buffer above observed peak; stress test results are summarized in the file.
- Availability & retention: Our production SLO is 99.9% for generation endpoints (monthly). Audit logs (access and request traces) are retained for 24 months for enterprise accounts; baseline retention for self-serve is 12 months. We included the retention policy excerpt and export logs sample.
- Compliance contact & audit: Our SOC2 auditor is Brightway Audits (contact: Kim Tran, kim.tran@brightwayaudits.com). Last SOC2 Type II report: 2026-03-01 (summary attached).

Attachments (included): redwood_change-control-runbook.pdf, deployment-sop-checklist.docx, capacity-planning-monthly-metrics-2026.csv, soc2-summary-2026.pdf

Next steps: If you'd like, we can walk through the artifacts in a 30–45 minute call. Please propose a time and we will bring product operations and infra.

Regards,
